dict.string: #!/bin/zsh export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$PATH" PYTHON="" for candidate in /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 "${commands[python3]}" /usr/bin/python3; do [[ -x "$candidate" ]] || continue # Avoid invoking Apple's developer-tool stub when no tools are installed. if [[ "$candidate" == /usr/bin/python3 ]]; then /usr/bin/xcode-select -p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue fi if "$candidate" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 6))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON="$candidate" break fi done if [[ -z "$PYTHON" ]]; then echo "Python 3 is required. Install Python 3 and retry." exit 0 fi "$PYTHON" markdown_actions.py convert "$@"

Install Python 3 and retry." exit 0 fi "$PYTHON" markdown_actions.py merge "$@"
# If you installed Python packages for python3: /usr/local/bin/python3 "$HOME/bin/ocr_md_single.py" "$@" # If python3 is elsewhere, adjust path (e.g., $(which python3))

Search with md followed by a filename or text. Use md alone to list up to 100 notes. Press Return to open a result.
Setup on another Mac: 1. Install Python 3 using Alfred’s official instructions: https://www.alfredapp.com/help/kb/install-dependencies/ No pip packages are required. Homebrew on Intel and Apple Silicon, python.org installations in /usr/local/bin, and working Apple developer-tools Python are detected. 2. In workflow configuration, set Notes folder if your vault is elsewhere. The default uses your current home folder and the Obsidian vault named csaborio. 3. In Finder, download the iCloud vault (Keep Downloaded where available).
Search checks filenames and relative paths first, then note content if no names match. Content scans stop after five seconds with a visible message if files are slow to read. Hidden folders are skipped. Folder::query syntax is not supported.
File actions: Convert to Markdown (MarkItDown): converts selected files beside their sources. Requires MarkItDown. Merge Markdown files: combines two or more .md/.markdown files in Alfred’s supplied order, separated by horizontal rules. Saves Merged.md beside the first input. Both actions preserve existing files by adding a numeric suffix. Merge preserves text, including front matter and relative links; it does not rewrite them.
Markdown from OCR: PDF file action migrated from OCR → Markdown (Spanish). Uses /usr/local/bin/python3 and ~/bin/ocr_md_single.py with the original multi-file arguments and notification. The helper and its OCR dependencies remain external.
Folder containing your Markdown notes. Use ~ for the current Mac user’s home folder.
Optional full path to the markitdown executable. Leave blank to detect common installations.
